title: Aloe-emodin inhibits nasopharyngeal carcinoma by modulating telomerase activity involving the c-Myc/E2F1 axis.
authors: Li, Mengqin; Li, Chunhong; Zeng, Xin; Hu, Jiahua; Su, Han; Huang, Jiayi; He, Min; Tang, Jianhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦荟大黄素通过c-Myc/E2F1轴调节端粒酶活性抑制鼻咽癌，虽涉及转录因子与hTERT调控及分子对接，但核心是药物抗肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The telomerase catalytic subunit hTERT is a critical oncogenic driver in nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). The specific role of aloe-emodin (AE) in regulating hTERT in NPC has not been systematically investigated. The regulatory network involving hTERT and its upstream transcription factors, c-Myc and E2F1, offers a promising therapeutic avenue. METHODS: Bioinformatics was used to analyze hTERT expression and its prognostic significance in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Molecular docking simulations were conducted to investigate the potential interaction between AE and hTERT. hTERT expression was assessed in normal nasal epithelial cells and NPC cell lines. Effects of AE on hTERT, c-Myc, and E2F1 were measured using qRT-PCR and Western blotting. Telomerase activity was evaluated through TRAP-qPCR and PAGE. hTERT was knocked down using siRNA. Cell proliferation, migration, and invasion were analyzed using CCK-8, EdU, colony formation, and Transwell assays. ROS levels were quantified using DCFH-DA staining. In vivo, a subcutaneous xenograft model was established to assess AE's anti-tumor efficacy alone and with shRNA-mediated hTERT knockdown. Organ toxicity was evaluated by H&E staining. Tumor tissues were analyzed by immunohistochemistry for hTERT, c-Myc, E2F1, Ki-67, and Cleaved Caspase-3. RESULTS: Bioinformatics analysis revealed elevated hTERT expression in HNSC tissues and NPC cell lines Molecular docking predicted a potential interaction between AE and the catalytic pocket of hTERT. In vitro, AE treatment decreased c-Myc, increased E2F1, and reduced hTERT transcription. AE also reduced telomerase activity, increased ROS levels, and suppressed proliferation, migration, and invasion in NPC cells. In vivo, AE showed anti-tumor activity. Combined with hTERT knockdown, AE produced synergistic tumor suppression and enhanced modulation of the c-Myc/E2F1/hTERT axis and oxidative stress. Immunohistochemistry revealed suppressed proliferation and increased apoptosis in tumor tissues of the combination group. No significant organ toxicity was observed. CONCLUSION: This study presents the first systematic validation of AE's anti-NPC effects. These include hTERT suppression, modulation of the c-Myc/E2F1 network, and induction of oxidative stress. These findings suggest a potential therapeutic target and strategy for NPC. The results support the clinical translation of AE.
abstract_zh: 背景：端粒酶催化亚基hTERT是鼻咽癌（NPC）中的关键致癌驱动因子。大黄素（AE）在鼻咽癌中调控hTERT的具体作用尚未被系统研究。涉及hTERT及其上游转录因子c-Myc和E2F1的调控网络为治疗提供了有前景的途径。方法：利用生物信息学分析hTERT在头颈鳞状细胞癌和鼻咽癌中的表达及其预后意义。进行分子对接模拟以研究AE与hTERT之间的潜在相互作用。在正常鼻上皮细胞和鼻咽癌细胞系中评估hTERT表达。使用qRT-PCR和Western blotting测量AE对hTERT、c-Myc和E2F1的影响。通过TRAP-qPCR和PAGE评估端粒酶活性。使用siRNA敲低hTERT。使用CCK-8、EdU、集落形成和Transwell实验分析细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭。使用DCFH-DA染色量化ROS水平。在体内，建立皮下异种移植模型以评估AE单独及与shRNA介导的hTERT敲低联合的抗肿瘤疗效。通过H&E染色评估器官毒性。通过免疫组织化学分析肿瘤组织中hTERT、c-Myc、E2F1、Ki-67和Cleaved Caspase-3的表达。结果：生物信息学分析显示HNSC组织和鼻咽癌细胞系中hTERT表达升高。分子对接预测AE与hTERT催化口袋之间存在潜在相互作用。在体外，AE处理降低c-Myc、增加E2F1并减少hTERT转录。AE还降低端粒酶活性、增加ROS水平，并抑制鼻咽癌细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭。在体内，AE显示出抗肿瘤活性。与hTERT敲低联合时，AE产生协同肿瘤抑制效应，并增强对c-Myc/E2F1/hTERT轴和氧化应激的调节。免疫组织化学显示联合组肿瘤组织中增殖受抑且凋亡增加。未观察到显著器官毒性。结论：本研究首次系统验证了AE的抗鼻咽癌效应，包括hTERT抑制、c-Myc/E2F1网络调节和氧化应激诱导。这些发现提示了鼻咽癌的潜在治疗靶点和策略。结果支持AE的临床转化。
